unit.title: Игровые платформы: компьютеры, консоли и портативные устройства

learning_outcomes.statement: Separates target device from delivery method, surveys desktop/console/handheld/mobile/web/XR, and states plainly that Pygame's native home is the desktop and consoles are closed to it.
